messages.author: MattyA
messages.text: Hot diggity dog I'm not on the shame list anymore time to get this season done

messages.text: When should we start pointing fingers?

messages.author: Pink_Elephants
messages.text: So how was Thanksgiving up north?

messages.author: GaelicGopher
messages.text:
So this is like season 100 of The W.  50/50 every year regarding Penalties.  Why don’t we just let the HOME team choose?  So if teams are at ends with decision…..each get their way.

Seams easy.  I’m sure you smart people in the hierarchy have already contemplated this. 

Momma ….you are appreciated.  #pac2

messages.author: Ticklepuss
messages.text: It’s easy to just forget to turn them on

messages.author: Ticklepuss
messages.text: Having said that, it’s not 50/50.  It’s more like 70/30 against them if i recall the last vote

messages.author: marylandmike.
messages.text: The majority will never win in here because of the purists. Tisi

messages.author: marylandmike.
messages.text: There’s nothing stopping dudes who don’t wanna play with penalties from playing without penalties, right?

messages.author: Ticklepuss
messages.text: I would miss complaining about penalties if they went away

messages.author: Pink_Elephants
messages.text: @segathon hijacked the entire penalties thing. He’s the only one stopping us from true change

messages.author: vancecookcobxin
messages.text: HOLYT SHIT......We cracked FIGHTING in NHL 95 BOYS:

messages.author: vancecookcobxin
messages.text: I wish I could show videos on discord but its coming along nicely

messages.author: segathon
messages.text: Did you copy over the nhl 93/94 fight patch?

messages.author: vancecookcobxin
messages.text: Yea pretty much got it from the NHL 94 fight mod and after @UltraMagnus found the lost fighting animations it was only a matter of time lol.....I think the last thing thats left is having the players pick up their gloves and stick after they are done

messages.author: vancecookcobxin
messages.text: dunno why the video looks so choppy....its actually fine irl

messages.author: vancecookcobxin
messages.text: test it out and let me know if you guys have any issues with it so I can make sure that its flawless. the fighting_test.bin starts off with fighting so you can play around with it

messages.author: segathon
messages.text: love it.  Will test it tonight!

messages.author: segathon
messages.text: @Leaguers check out stream above. Did the new way of playing via browser no retro arch, no port forwarding, no bullshit 🙂

messages.author: NathanMB
messages.text: That’s a game changer. Notice any differences ?

messages.author: Ticklepuss
messages.text: I believe there is an upload button on the page somewhere

messages.author: halifax
messages.text: The game is saved on the site. As for uploadable saved states, i know Chaos is working with this new system to integrate it with the nhl94online.com site. Meaning there that eventually, there will be no requirement to save the state anymore, the game is uploaded for you.

messages.author: halifax
messages.text: it is the easiest system i have ever encountered for playing online. I've played guys from overseas, and I played a guy yesterday who was on his phone using a Bluetooth controller. Pretty much all my experiences have been perfect.  One guy in Finland chopped a couple times but it was still a fine game.

messages.author: halifax
messages.text: i really think you guys will love it!

messages.author: segathon
messages.text: its very smooth, no jitter or multiverse stuff I saw.   It's a little slower than my RA play, but I think it could be closer to OG game.  (That is why I always lose at gopher tailgates)  There could be just a minor input lag on control.  Will need to play around with it a little bit to see if there is some.  Noticed on manual goalie was a little slippery.

messages.author: UltraMagnus
messages.text: Yeah maybe some adjustments. Did you llay 95 on it.

messages.author: segathon
messages.text: yup they have 94 in GENS and SNES and 95 GENS.  Thanks @halifax for adding us!!!!
